Aisha (People Ops): Heads-up — new hire Andre Kim starts Mon 08/08. Need on-site I-9 verification, background check confirmation, laptop imaging, and benefits enrollment. Who can cover reception handoff? 
Priya (Hiring Manager): I'll be on campus that morning and can meet at reception at 08:50 to bring him up. 
Ken (Facilities): Reception staffed. I can pre-print a temporary badge and have a desk sign. What's the job code for badge? 
Aisha (People Ops): Job code ENG-SWE-2. Please print a temporary badge and schedule him for a photo if we don't have one. Also note: background check must clear before permanent badge is issued (security policy). 
bg-check-bot: Background check link sent to andre.kim@redwood.ai — status: pending. First reminder in 6 hours.
Priya (Hiring Manager): He said he'd bring passport. If so we can do I-9 on the spot. If he brings driver's license + SS card, that's fine too. 
it-bot: Laptop imaging slot available 09:00-09:30, MacBook Air 13 reserved. MDM enrollment auto-starts after image. 
Aisha (People Ops): Please add him to payroll so benefits enrollment email goes out same day. Also ensure W-4 + direct deposit are completed before Friday payroll cutoff or we'll have to run exception. 
Ken (Facilities): Quick logistics: elevator badge will be activated after permanent badge issuance. Temporary badge gives lobby access only. Shuttle from satellite lot can drop at 08:30 if he needs it. 
Priya (Hiring Manager): I'll remind him to complete the GoodHire form tonight. If it's not green by Monday morning, can we still let him start with limited access? 
Aisha (People Ops): Yes — allowed to start onboarding tasks, but no access to prod systems until BG check green and permanent badge issued. Put "Limited Access" in the HRIS notes. 
bg-check-bot: Update: candidate completed consent form. Status: screening in progress. 
it-bot: FYI: I'll leave a spare USB-C dongle and ethernet adapter in the laptop sleeve. Also will attach pre-created github/email accounts; password reset link will be emailed to his personal address. 
Aisha (People Ops): Action items summary: 1) Ken — temp badge & photo if needed 2) Priya — meet at reception 08:50 & confirm passport or doc combo 3) IT — imaging 09:00 slot + laptop labelled "Andre K" 4) Hiring — remind candidate to finish BG check tonight 5) People Ops — add payroll & benefits enrollment email. 
Priya (Hiring Manager): Thanks — see you Monday. 
Aisha (People Ops): Thanks team :tada: — I'll post the final day-1 checklist to Andre and cc Priya.
